observations.environment_en: Chrome on macOS · desktop · no account
observations.environment_zh: macOS Chrome · 桌面 · 无账户
observations.summary_en: One local two-player round reached an X win.
observations.summary_zh: 一局本地双人游戏完成，X 获胜。

steps.action_en: Open a fresh board in the default two-player mode.
steps.result_en: The board was empty; X had the first turn and all score counters were zero.
steps.action_zh: 打开默认双人模式的新棋盘。
steps.result_zh: 棋盘为空，轮到 X，所有比分为零。

steps.action_en: Click cell 1, then click the occupied cell 1 again.
steps.result_en: The first click placed X and changed the turn to O. The second click did not replace X or change the turn.
steps.action_zh: 点击格子 1，再次点击已占用的格子 1。
steps.result_zh: 第一次点击放置 X 并切换到 O；第二次点击没有覆盖棋子或改变回合。

steps.action_en: Click cells 4, 2, 5 and 3, in that order.
steps.result_en: O and X alternated. X filled the top row; the page announced an X win and increased the X score to 1.
steps.result_zh: O 与 X 交替落子。X 占据首行，页面宣布 X 获胜，X 比分增加到 1。

steps.action_en: After the win, click the empty cell 9.
steps.result_en: Cell 9 stayed empty and the winner and score remained unchanged.
steps.result_zh: 格子 9 保持为空，胜方和比分没有变化。

observations.scope_en: Cells are numbered left to right, top to bottom. This covers one win, occupied-cell handling and terminal-state handling. Draws, computer-opponent strategy, saved scores, customization and mobile behavior were not tested; AI authorship remains the publisher’s claim.
observations.scope_zh: 格子按从左到右、从上到下编号。本记录覆盖一次获胜、已占用格子及终局处理；未测试平局、电脑对手策略、比分保存、自定义或手机表现。AI 开发方式仍依据发布者声明。

screenshot.caption_en: Observed final board: X across the top row and X score 1. Demo by OpenAI’s coding-example collection.
screenshot.caption_zh: 实际终局：X 占据首行，X 比分为 1。演示来自 OpenAI 编程案例集。

observations.environment_en: Chrome on macOS · desktop · no account
observations.environment_zh: macOS Chrome · 桌面 · 无账户
observations.summary_en: Product filtering opened the matching history page.
observations.summary_zh: 商品筛选可进入匹配的历史页面。

steps.action_en: Open the home page and choose Product Prices.
steps.result_en: The product table loaded with a search field and a note about products with at least six collected prices.
steps.action_zh: 打开首页并选择 Product Prices。
steps.result_zh: 商品表格加载，显示搜索框，以及至少收集六次价格的商品说明。

steps.result_en: The page displayed the matching-products message and a Large Eggs row.
steps.result_zh: 页面显示匹配商品说明及 Large Eggs 记录。

steps.result_en: The URL changed to /products/large-eggs. The Large Eggs heading, price chart and dated history table rendered. Some rows were explicitly labeled Estimate.
steps.action_zh: 打开 Large Eggs 链接。
steps.result_zh: 网址变为 /products/large-eggs；商品标题、价格图表和带日期的历史表格显示，部分行明确标注为 Estimate。

observations.scope_en: This checks navigation, filtering and visible history rendering only. It does not validate recorded prices, chart calculations, completeness, retailer coverage, freshness or mobile behavior. The chart’s right-edge price label was clipped in the captured desktop view.
observations.scope_zh: 仅检查导航、筛选及历史内容的可见呈现；未验证价格记录、图表计算、完整性、零售商覆盖、时效或手机表现。截图中的图表右侧价格标签有裁切。

screenshot.caption_en: Large Eggs history view after keyword filtering and navigation. Website by Jim Lawruk; displayed prices are not independently validated.
screenshot.caption_zh: 关键词筛选及跳转后的 Large Eggs 历史页面。网站由 Jim Lawruk 制作，图中价格未独立验证。

observations.environment_en: Chrome on macOS · desktop · publisher sample · no account
observations.environment_zh: macOS Chrome · 桌面 · 发布者内置样例 · 无账户
observations.summary_en: The sample changed from a two-series line chart to a Sales-only bar chart.
observations.summary_zh: 样例从双数据列折线图切换为仅含 Sales 的柱状图。

steps.action_en: Open the demo without selecting a file.
steps.result_en: A default dataset loaded, with a line chart showing Sales and Profit.
steps.result_zh: 默认数据加载，折线图显示 Sales 和 Profit。

steps.result_en: The control and chart label changed to Bar; the visible chart used vertical bars.
steps.action_zh: 在 Chart type 中选择 Bar。
steps.result_zh: 控件及图表标签变为 Bar，画面显示竖直柱形。

steps.action_en: Uncheck Profit while leaving Sales selected.
steps.result_en: Profit disappeared from the chart legend and the color controls; Sales remained visible.
steps.result_zh: Profit 从图例及颜色控件中消失，Sales 仍显示。

steps.result_en: The button was activated, but completed file creation was not verified. The page continued to show the same bar chart.
steps.result_zh: 按钮已触发，但没有确认文件生成完成；页面继续显示同一柱状图。

observations.scope_en: This covers chart-type and dataset-visibility controls on the publisher’s built-in sample. No file was uploaded, and CSV parsing, numeric correctness, colors, pie/doughnut modes and mobile behavior were not tested. PNG export remains unconfirmed; a download-observation timeout alone does not prove an application failure.
observations.scope_zh: 仅覆盖发布者内置样例上的图表类型和数据列显隐。未上传文件，也未测试 CSV 解析、数值正确性、颜色、饼图／环形图或手机表现。PNG 导出仍未确认，下载观察超时本身不能证明应用故障。

screenshot.caption_en: Observed Sales-only bar chart using the embedded sample. Demo published by OpenAI; chart rendering uses Chart.js.
screenshot.caption_zh: 使用内置样例实际显示的单列 Sales 柱状图。演示由 OpenAI 发布，图表使用 Chart.js 渲染。

observations.environment_en: Chrome on macOS · desktop · synthetic text · no account
observations.environment_zh: macOS Chrome · 桌面 · 合成文本 · 无账户
observations.summary_en: Typed Markdown produced two slides with working previous/next navigation.
observations.summary_zh: 输入的 Markdown 生成两页预览，并可前后翻页。

steps.action_en: Replace the initial sample with two synthetic slides separated by a line containing three hyphens.
steps.result_en: The preview updated to Slide 1 of 2, with the Sample deck heading and its paragraph.
steps.action_zh: 把初始示例替换为两页合成文本，以独立一行的三个连字符分隔。
steps.result_zh: 预览更新为 Slide 1 of 2，显示 Sample deck 标题及正文。

steps.result_en: The counter showed Slide 2 of 2. The Second slide heading and an Apples/Oranges bullet list were visible.
steps.result_zh: 计数显示 Slide 2 of 2，出现 Second slide 标题及 Apples／Oranges 项目列表。

steps.result_en: The counter returned to Slide 1 of 2 and the first heading and paragraph reappeared.
steps.result_zh: 计数回到 Slide 1 of 2，第一页面的标题及正文重新显示。

observations.scope_en: This checks basic heading/paragraph/list rendering, the slide delimiter and two navigation buttons using synthetic text. It does not test broader Markdown conformance, images, fullscreen, keyboard shortcuts, persistence or mobile behavior. Source review found no built-in file-export feature; no export was attempted.
observations.scope_zh: 使用合成文本检查基本标题、段落、列表、分隔符及两个翻页按钮。未测试更多 Markdown 兼容性、图片、全屏、快捷键、持久化或手机表现。源码核查未发现内置文件导出功能，本次也未尝试导出。

screenshot.caption_en: Observed second slide and two-slide counter beside the synthetic Markdown input. Demo published by OpenAI.
screenshot.caption_zh: 合成 Markdown 输入旁实际显示的第二页及两页计数。演示由 OpenAI 发布。
